name: workbench-v1
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished, realistic desktop web application interface design screenshot, landscape 16:9, crisp readable simplified Chinese. Product: Creative Agent Studio, a professional human-and-Agent collaborative creative studio for content operators. This is an interface design, not a photographed monitor, no perspective, no browser chrome, no device frame. Full bleed UI. Art direction: calm editorial production desk, warm off-white #F6F5F1 canvas, white working surfaces, near-black #202D29 typography, deep forest green #214E3E primary actions, pale sage selection #E5EDE7, warm amber waiting status; fine neutral dividers, minimal shadows, precise 8px spacing, modest 8px corner radius. Typography modern Chinese sans serif, strong headings, generous readable body, no purple gradients, no decorative hero. Domain signature is a narrow numbered page strip like a production contact sheet. All content fictional. Tiny top label '界面设计 · 虚构示例'. Layout: left sidebar 220px equivalent, center conversation 500px, right editable production workspace 720px, harmonious spacious 1440x900 proportions. Left: simple geometric studio mark, 'Creative Studio', green '+ 新建创作'; '创作工作台', '素材库', 'DNA', '模型与服务'; task section '最近任务' with active '春日阅读指南' and amber '待确认制作单', two quiet tasks '周末书店海报' and '亲子阅读清单'; bottom 'DNA 未启用' and muted '本地工作区'. Top main header '春日阅读指南', '3 页图文', small task context '示例任务 · 草案 v2', top right outlined '打开 Canvas ↗'. Thin task phase ribbon across main: '需求已确认' check, '参考已确认' check, active '制作单待确认', '绘图', '审核与导出' muted. Center heading '创作对话'; flowing chat transcript without nested cards. User small bubble: '做一组春日阅读指南，面向亲子家庭，温暖、清爽，分成 3 页。' Agent small emerald monogram then '已整理为 3 页。第 2 页按你的意见减少文字，请检查右侧制作单。'; a compact reference block '已保留 2 份参考' with two warm fictional book-cover thumbnails, small '查看 / 调整'; visible secondary '查看过程记录' collapsed, no chain of thought. Below plain amber notice '等待你确认制作单后开始绘图'; ample breathing room. Bottom composer anchored '告诉我想改哪里…', attachment icon, green square send button, footer 'Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行'. Right header '制作单' and 'v2 · 未确认', tabs '参考素材', selected '制作单', '成品审核'; beneath header '可直接编辑每页文案与画面要求'. Left narrow page navigator three numbered miniature cream posters: '01 封面', active '02 阅读方法', '03 行动清单'. Main editing area selected page '第 2 页 / 阅读方法', '尺寸 3:4'; labeled editable '页面文案' containing readable '每天 15 分钟，一起读一本书' and '先观察插图，再轮流朗读，最后聊聊最喜欢的片段。'; '画面要求' text field '暖白底色，书页与嫩绿植物，标题清晰，保留充足留白。'; '采用的参考' two thin removable reference chips; calm small note '本次 DNA：未启用'. Footer fixed bottom of right pane one quiet '保存修改', large forest green primary '确认 v2 并开始绘图'. Everything resembles a usable premium actual web app, not a dashboard of generic statistic cards. No Canvas redesign shown. The screenshot is one logically consistent waiting-for-production-sheet-confirmation state; no contradictory generated progress, no enabled export or final approval. Chinese labels especially main navigation and primary buttons must be clean and legible.
